welcome: Welcome! Sell keys for supported AI providers and request payouts. Verification currently uses a test CSV only; it does not establish live provider validity.
about_text: Test API key marketplace. Credits are based on CSV records. Administrators process payouts manually.
enter_key: Send a key as a message. Use synthetic test keys only. We match its HMAC fingerprint against the CSV; the key is not retained in history.
progress_region: 2/5 CSV regional flag read. The second-accepted-key test rule is determined within the transaction.
progress_calculation: 4/5 Calculating at the product rate; 20% reduction only for the second accepted key.
progress_commit: 5/5 Checking duplicate, exchange rate and atomically saving the credit…
key_not_found: Key not found in the test CSV. Try another key.
invalid_key: Test record is invalid or ineligible.
csv_unavailable: Test CSV is unavailable or malformed. No credit was issued.
duplicate_key: This key has already been processed. No duplicate credit.
rate_unavailable: Current exchange rate unavailable. No credit was issued. Retry the saved verification below.
pending_saved: Pending verification saved without the plaintext key.
invalid_amount: Enter a positive amount with at most two decimal places.
invalid_destination: Check the card or wallet format and selected network.
invalid_input: Invalid input. Check the format and try again.
currency_changed: Currency has changed. Start a new withdrawal.
onboarding_required: First select language and currency using /start.
rate_limited: Too many submissions. Wait a few seconds.
invalid_transition: Status has changed; this action is unavailable.
generic_error: Unable to complete this action. Try later; financial operations are protected against retries.
choose_option: Select card type or asset and network
enter_amount: Enter withdrawal amount in the selected currency. Minimum
enter_destination: Enter card number or wallet address. Format checks do not verify ownership or a transfer. The message will be deleted where possible.
withdraw_created: Request created and funds reserved. An administrator will pay manually.
legal_fallback: Link has not been configured. Contact support.
contact_fallback: Support contact has not been configured.
json_product: Send product JSON. Creation requires id, name_ru, name_en, rate (string). Updates need id and changed fields. Optional: description_ru/en, conditions_ru/en, active, display_order, image. Example:
json_config: Send JSON: {"key":"welcome.en","value":"Text"}. Keys and formats are documented in README. Use the image section for uploads.
json_crypto: Send asset JSON: id, asset, network, address_kind (evm/tron/solana/ton), active. Updates need only id and changed fields.
json_admin: Send JSON: {"id":123456789,"active":true}. false disables an administrator.
image_prompt: Send a photo. Caption: main, catalog, profile, withdraw, about, welcome, support or product:ID. To remove: JSON {"key":"image.main","value":null} in settings.
reason_prompt: Enter a reason for rejection or returning funds.
notification_retry: Notification may not have been delivered. Administrators can find the request in withdrawals.
